title: Solar Power
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / Solar power is a useful energy

dialogue.t: Lily, what are those on the roof?
They are solar panels. They use sunlight to make electricity.
Is solar power a useful type of energy?
Yes. It is clean, and the sun never runs out.
They will run out one day, and they make the air dirty.
So we should use more solar power.

vocab: solar 太阳能的 · electricity 电 · energy 能源 · run out 用完 · dirty 脏的 · useful 有用的
